data.name: Ozzy
data.gender_notes: Ozzy is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English oss, meaning 'strength' or 'power'. The name Ozzy is often associated with courage and determination. The name Ozzy carries the meaning “Strong, powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ozzy usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of inner strength and resilience
data.etymology: Ozzy belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ozzy total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: עוזי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עוזי (Ozi) - שם ישראלי, עוז (Oz) - צורת העז, אוזר (Ozar) - ספיקה, עצמאות - תכונה של העז, במקרא, עוזי הוא נשיא העיר שכם, בתקופת שושנק (שושנק 1:1), ואחד משבעת הנסיכים של שלמה (מלכים א:25:18)

in_greek.name: Οζύ
in_greek.long_meaning: Οζύ (Ozy) - το ονομα, ούγιος (hygos) - εθισμός, φιλότης - φιλία, στη Βίβλο, Οζύς (Ozy) είναι απεσταλμένος του Θεού, ο οποίος δίνει χρηματιστές και προφήτες στην Αίγυπτο (Δεούτη, 7:11), και ο οποίος καταστρέφει την Αίγυπτο με το θάνατο όλων των πρώτων γονέων

in_latin.name: Ozzy
in_latin.long_meaning: Ozzy - ex nomine Hebraico Oz, fortitudo, virtus, firmitas, in Biblia, Ozzy est minister Dei, qui dat prophetas et mercatores in Aegyptum, Et qui Aegyptum delet cum morte omnium primorum parentum

in_english.name: Ozzy
in_english.long_meaning: Ozzy - derived from Hebrew 'Oz', meaning courage, strength, bravery, boldness, vigor, in the Bible, Ozzy is a divine messenger who gives prophets and traders to Egypt, and who destroys Egypt with the death of all the first parents, as a given name, Ozzy is used in Christian culture to signify boldness and resilience, and is often associated with the qualities of a strong and courageous person, Ozzy is also the name of a famous rock musician, Ozzy Osbourne, who is known for his bold and fearless stage presence

data.cultural_impact: Ozzy Osbourne, a legendary figure in heavy metal music, has succeeded in making the name Ozzy synonymous with boldness and rebellion. With his iconic image of a long-haired, leather-clad rockstar biting the head off a bat, Ozzy has broken down barriers and redefined what it means to be a rock musician. Over the decades, he has influenced countless artists and inspired generations of fans to embrace their individuality and challenge societal norms.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian faith, the name Ozzy carries a deeper spiritual significance, reminding us of the power and strength that comes from God. Like the power of the fasting and praying Apostle Ozzy of Tebessa, bishop and confessor, the name Ozzy evokes images of strength in the face of adversity and unwavering faith. It is a reminder that with God, we have the strength and power to overcome any challenge, staying true to our beliefs and values.
